headline: Granted Special Permit #206-26 at 4 Linden Ave and approved 24-hour McDonald's hours at 230 Elliott Street
summary: The board granted Special Permit #206-26 for 4 Linden Ave, allowing parking and driveway spacing relief for a new dwelling. It also approved a modification to Site Plan Review #38-98 for 230 Elliott Street, changing McDonald's operating hours to 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Minutes from July 21, 2026 and August 18, 2026 were also approved.
decisions: Closed the public hearing for Special Permit #206-26.
Adopted the Findings of Fact for Special Permit #206-26.
Granted Special Permit #206-26 at 4 Linden Street, as presented, with the information from the Parking & Traffic Commission memo.
Deemed the modification request for Site Plan Review #38-98 at 230 Elliott Street to be minor.
Granted the modification request for Site Plan Review #38-98 at 230 Elliott Street, changing McDonald's hours to 24/7/365.
Approved the July 21, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended.
Approved the August 18, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to close the Public Hearing for Special Permit #206-26. Vigorito seconds. Motion carries unanimously by roll call (6-0).
Motion to adopt the Findings of Fact, as presented and discussed. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously by roll call (6-0).

Motion to grant the Special Permit #206-26 at 4 Linden Street, as presented, with the information indicated on the memo from the Parking & Traffic Commission dated September 11, 2026. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously by roll call (6-0).
Motion to deem the modification request for Site Plan Review #38-98 at 230 Elliott Street, to be Minor. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously by roll call (6-0).
Motion to grant the modification request for Site Plan Review #38-98 at 230 Elliott Street. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously by roll call (6-0).
Motion to approve the meeting minutes of July 21, 2026, as amended. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously by roll call (7-0).
Motion to approve the meeting minutes of August 18, 2026, as amended. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously by roll call (7-0).
